# Test data

`swh-20261101T00-024h.grib2`: significant wave height from ECMWF IFS open
data (wave stream, 0.25 degree), run 2026-11-01 00 UTC, step 24 h. One GRIB2
message cut from `20261101000000-24h-wave-fc.grib2` with an HTTP range request
from the run's `.index` file.
